text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The interior ministry has closed down the coded communcations channel between the police and the Russian interior ministry.
- The town of Rapla has completed the first stage of its waste water treatment plant with Finnish help.
- A foundation for oldest university Tartu was begun to collect funds to support the university.
- Shoppers had a narrow escape in one of the main Tallinn stores when a large chunk of plaster at the Tallinn Department store crashed to the ground. Noone was injured.
- Estonia does not want a charter with NATO as this woild result in a special relationship and prevent it from joining the alliance, NATO ambassador Juroi Luik said.
- President Lennart Meri left for the NATO Madrid summit.
